nonBlockingIssues.description: Edge case in retry path: if the retry SELECT (fetch_one) finds no rows because the group was closed or expired between the failed INSERT and the retry, it will return a RowNotFound error propagated as a 500. This is extremely unlikely in practice (sub-millisecond window) and self-correcting (next request will create a new group), but a fetch_optional + retry-create could make it fully robust.
